title: Digital Accessibility & User Research Associate
description: Organisation: Vokx InclusiveLocation: Coimbatore, Tamil NaduWork mode: On-siteVokx Inclusive is exploring a new initiative focused on connecting people with disabilities to digital accessibility research and real-user testing.We are looking for a professional with experience or a strong interest in digital accessibility, WCAG testing, assistive technologies, inclusive UX and usability research.What we are looking forExperience in digital accessibility testing or WCAG evaluation.Understanding of screen readers such as JAWS, NVDA or VoiceOver.Knowledge of how people with disabilities interact with websites and applications.Experience in usability testing or user research involving people with disabilities.Understanding of participant recruitment and research coordination is an advantage.Role and responsibilitiesUnderstand the digital accessibility testing ecosystem in India.Explore the need for real users with disabilities in accessibility testing.Identify gaps in participant recruitment and coordination.Help develop a network of people with disabilities interested in participating in accessibility research.Explore collaborations with accessibility consultancies, UX research agencies and technology companies.Support the development and coordination of real-user testing initiatives.Who can apply?Accessibility engineers, WCAG testers, accessibility consultants, UX researchers, usability testing professionals and assistive technology specialists.We particularly welcome applicants with practical experience in real-user accessibility testing.ApplySend your CV and a brief introduction about your experience to:vokxinclusive@gmail.comSubject: Digital Accessibility & User Research AssociateJoin us in building a more inclusive digital ecosystem by bringing real user experiences into accessibility research.
